entities.summary: The Dyavolski most is an arch bridge over the Arda River in a narrow gorge in southern-central Bulgaria. It is 10 km from the Bulgarian town of Ardino in the Rhodope Mountains and is part of the ancient road connecting the lowlands of Thrace with the north Aegean Sea coast.
